zin bris rig 'dzin zhal lung dge'o/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/klong chen snying thig rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i mcha

tei:div.tei:p: zin bris rig 'dzin zhal lung dge'o// bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ klong chen snying thig rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa bzung ba'i tshul las 'grigs cung zad 'god pa la/ thog mar sems bskyed sdom chog gi mchod pa byin rlabs la zhi rol/ spyan 'dren mthar zhi rol bcas rim par btang*/ sdom chog dngos blang zin nas/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi sogs tshig bdun gsol 'debs lan gsum/ e ma ho/ spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams sogs bla ma sku gsum gyi gsol 'debs dang*/ chos sku kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa yiḥ sogs/ 'di ltar mig gi sogs/ bdag 'dra'i rang rgyud grol bar byin gyis rlobs// 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i sogs/ de nas rang gzhung gi gsol 'debs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya/ gzhan yang bla ma rig 'dzin dpal chen 'dus pa'i sogs dang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sogs skabs su gang bab de nyid dmigs bsal nas/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa lan gsum mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo'i skur gyur/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs zhing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis dkar bgegs gnyis ka brlabs te/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ s+tha na pa ti k+ṣe ṭa pa lañca na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo= sogs lan gsum/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol// zhes pa'i mjug tu dkar gtor gshegs la zhi rol bya/

bhu mi pa ti ya hi gats+tsha/ ༈ sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes lan gcig la lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bca'/ sarba bighāṃ na maḥsarba sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis bsngo/ las byang gi 'di nas bzung rnga brdung gi rnga chog thams cad sum brdung kho na yin pas/ thang gsum dang 'bebs sum gnyis OO o OOO o OOO oo hrīḥ snod bcud sogs dang mtshams gcod la 'jug O rdo rjesaṃ gzhoṃm/ o OOO o sum gcig dang 'bebs sum gnyis nas/ srung 'khor mtshams gcod do: sum gnyis/ byin 'bebs mthar sum gcig sngags 'bebs 'og bzhag rol/ mchod brlabs/ sngags mthar sum gnyis/ lha bskyed rnga 'don/ spyan 'dren mgor/ sum gnyis/ spyan 'dren mthar 'jam rol/ sngags sum gnyis/ mchod pa mthar 'jam rol sum gnyis/ bstod pa'i mthar sum gcig 'bebs 'og yig brgya bzhag rol/ bzlas dmigs/ bsnyen pa sid+dhi khri/ gab byang dmigs pa/ bzlas pa stong lnga'am gcig thugs ka'i sngags= sogs/ hūm̐/ bzlas ci nus/ mjug tu dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bcas lan gsum/ rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod phreng gi sprin gzungs mthar zhi rol/ dbyangs dang sngags rgya spel bas lha mo bzhi re'i mtshams su zhi rol re/ de'i rjes su rang gzhung gi mchod pa/ zhi rol/ dril stabs med pa'i bstod pa rtsa gdangs rigs lnga spyi phyag mthar yig brgya tshar gcig bcas/ 'di nas ma mgon lcam dral gyi gsol kha la 'jug spyan 'dren mgor gnad yig gi srog sngags bzla/ thang gsum 'bebs sum gnyis gshin rje'i bar gdangs kyis/ bh+yo/ khrag mtsho lcags kyi ra ba sogs/ gdangs mtshams sum gnyis/ mthing nag g.yu yi sogs nas/ nasaḥ skad cig yud/ sngags 'bebs 'og sum gnyis/ bzhugs gsol rjes bskang ba'i mgor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ bh+yoḥ ting 'dzin sprul pa'i sogs lan gsum/ lan phyi ma rnams la'ang 'bru gsum sbyar/ de nas 'khrugs skong la/

sngags drug dril bcas phyag rgya drug gam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ thang gcig O o sum gnyis/ 'khrugs skong lan gsum/ de nas phud phyar la/ gsol lo sogs/ thang gcig 'bebs bzhag rol re bya/ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa sogs/ rgyas pa byed tshe thams cad lan gsum re re bzhin bsags/ bsdu na/ ma mo/ mgon po/ dam can gsum lan gsum re/ gzhan rnams lan re/ rgyun du phud phyar mi dgos/ de ltar srid pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor du ye shes dang sogs kyis/ zhi ba'i phrin las kyis dul bar mdzod cig nas rol mo gcig brgyab/ rgyas pa'i phrin las la gcig dbang gi phrin las la gcig drag po'i phrin las la gcig mjug tu 'ur sum brdung mthar/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan rang byung rgyal mo ni: sogs bstod pa dang*/ skye med rdo rje sogs mnga' gsol dang*/ bh+yoḥ sum cu rtsa gsum sogs phrin bcol/ de nas/ hri shag ru rag ram na ge tsit+ta traṃ ma ma yo za gh+raṃ ha he ke sha la dzaḥdzaḥ thang gsum 'bebs sum gnyis/ hrīḥ dur khrod rab 'jigs sogs gza' bdud skong ba lan gsum dang*/ kyai/ rang snang 'od gsal sogs tshe ring ma'i spyan 'dren mgor thang gsum 'bebs sum gnyis kyis btang*/ skong ba'i mgor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ bde chen chos sku'i klong yangs sogs nas/ mthu rtsal can la bdag bstod do// bar lan gsum/ de nas/ rgyal dbang pad+ma sogs/ bsnyen pa cung zad bzla/ g.yu sgron ma'i/ kyai/ mdun du sogs/ sngags 'bul lan gsum/ bstod pa/ hūm̐/ rdo rje g.yu sgron sogs dang*/ bde chen kun tu bzang mo'i kai la sha/ sogs mnga' gsol bya'o/ de nas ngan ne ma/ bh+yoḥ phyogs phyogs sogs/ sngags 'bul lan gsum/ bh+yoḥ dur khrod chen po sogs/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs par mdzod: bar brjod/ de nas rtsi dmar/ hrī pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa/ bdag nyid sogs/ thang gsum 'bebs sum gnyis/ kyai/ phyogs phyogs de ni sogs tshang ma lan gsum/

hūm̐/ spros bral chos kyi sku las saugs rgyal chen sku lnga/ hrī/ ljon shing brag ri bcas lan gcig raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ gser skyems zag pa med pa= rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ sku gsum brgyud gsum bla ma sogs kyi mjug tu/ phud phyar gyi gser skyems dang bcas pa bkyag ste/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyi// sogs mthar sum gcig 'bebs bzhag rol/ de nas/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ e ma ho/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma rgyal sogs/ yig brgya brgya rtsa bzlas/ ho/ zhi khro rab 'byams sogs nas/ skong ba rnams la zhi rol re/ mar me'i smon lam dang bcas pa'i mjug tu/ nam mkha'i mthar thug sogs kyi dus phyag dang bcas tshogs zhus/ de nas sum gnyis/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid thugs las raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ sogs dang*/ spyan 'dren mgor sum gnyis kyis btang*/ spyan 'dren mthar 'jam rol sum gnyis kyis phud dang bshags pa'i mthar yig brgya brjod/ bsgral ba la/ nri tri badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas bkug la/ hūm̐/ ma rig las nyon sogs bsgral te bstab la/ rang gzhung gi skong ba yod na 'dir btang*/ spyi rgyug tsam la rdo rje'i thol glu/ na mo/ bde gshegs snying pos sogs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum/ thang gcig sum gnyis/ āḥ rang byung lhun grub sogs nas/ lhun grub rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la skyol: bar btang*/ tshogs grangs gsog tshe 'dir/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshogs rdzas 'dod yon mthar/ ka dag phyogs yan chen po'i dgongs pa la: bsgrang bya'i theg pa tha dad ma grub kyang : kun rtog gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa'i phyir: theg pa rim dgur shar ba'i thugs dam bskang : zhes pa sbrel nas btang*/ ci tsam gsog 'dod pa tshar ba dang*/ mdor na rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i sogs 'di dus gnam phud btang*/

gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du a: bar sum gcig 'bebs bzhag rol bcas btang*/ phyag bcas drang ba la/ ho/ bla ma dpa' bo chen po sogs dang*/ ho/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs kyis lan btab/ yang na/ ho/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol/ lan du/ a la la ho/ brjod/ ho/ bdag lus phung khams sogs kyis rol/ drang dus bza' ba g.yas dang btung ba g.yon du bzung nas bla ma la drangs/ bla ma'i mdun nas bdud rtsi g.yon bskor dang bza' ba g.yas bskor gyis tshe mdud phog par drang dgos/ bsam lhun btang*/ sags rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng gis// bdag sogs rjes bzung tshe rabs thams cad du// 'gal rkyen kun zhi bsam don lhun grub nas// mthar thug pad+ma 'od du skye bar shog /ces brjod nas phyag bcas lhag zhus bya/ lhag ma la/ oṃ a ka ro sogs kyis brlabs te/ thang gcig sum gnyis/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i mu ran la: sogs mthar sum gcig 'bebs bzhag rol bcas btang*/ bla ma rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor du// tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba yis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /ces brjod/ de nas thang gcig sum brdung*/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha: sogs bskul ba btang*/ mthar rnga med/ de nas/ na mo rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma sogs nas/ khyad par du lcam dral bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa sogs gtor 'gugs tshar gcig gi da dgra nas rol zhabs btang mthar 'gugs rol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hoḥ oṃ ma hā kā la ya/ sha sa na sogs sngags 'bul lan gsum/ hūm̐/ skad cig dran rdzogs rang mdun sogs dang*/ na maḥshrī badz+ra dharma pā la ya/ tshangs pa mgrin sngon sogs dang*/ oṃ/ ye shes las grub mngon shes sogs bshags pa dang*/ sum brdung gis/ kyai/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen 'bar ba'i snod// sogs kyis/ khyim na gnas kyang yang dag sogs kyi dus gtor 'bul phyir bskyal/

tshogs gnyis 'bras bur smin pa'i bkra shis stsol// bar sum gcig 'bebs 'og oṃ a ka ros brlabs te/ sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe 'og min sogs chad tho dang*/ bstan ma'i mgor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ dpal gyi bka' nyan sogs ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ mthar sum gnyis/ nri tri badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: sogs/ mthar sum gcig 'bebs bzhag de nas gzhung gi mchod pa zhi rol/ bstod pa dang*/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: mchod rdzas ma tshang sogs bshags pa'i mthar yig brgya lan gsum btang*/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i sogs dngos grub blang*/ sgrub gter spos bcas gnas gsum tu gtug de nas/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs/ ye dharma sogs/ su pra tiṣ+thas brtan bzhugs dang*/ ho/ chu las sogs bsdu ldang dang*/ ho/ dus gsum bsags pa'i sogs bsngo smon dang*/ oṃ ye dharma sogs dang thang gcig sum brdung gis/ ho/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bkra shis mthar sum gnyis thang gsum 'bebs OO oo bzhag rol bya'o/ de nas/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sogs bzang spyod dang*/ dngos grub rgya mtsho dang*/ na mo gu ru/ bskal mang gong nas ma'i smon lam btab/ rgyal ba kun gyi nye lam sogs/ thub bstan mdzes pa'i sogs smon lam bya'o// dpal chen 'dus pa yang rig 'dus ltar la/ yum bka' la/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ bka' bsgo mtshams gcod byin 'bebs rnams rig 'dus nang nas len/ tshogs bshags pa'i rjes su skong ba sbyar/ tshogs grangs gsog dus/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod zhing : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas: sogs zhabs drung tshang gi tshig bsdu ltar bsags/ rig 'dus rang gzhung gi tshogs grangs gsog dus/ oṃ/ dus gsum bde gshegs saugs nas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// hūm̐/

bka' gsang rmad du byung sogs/ rang gzhung gi hūm̐/ bdag nyid thugs nas sogs tshogs phud bshags pa bsgral ba lhag ma rnams btang*/ mtsho dbus ge sar dang*/ o rgyan rin po che la sogs gang rung btang*/ yang oṃ dus gsum ma'am/ oṃ/ gzhi thog dang po sogs gang rung btang*/ hūm̐/ bka' gsang sogs/ tshogs byin rlabs nas lhag ma'i bar 'dra'o// gzhan rkang ḍa dung dkar dmar sogs btang tshul gsang chen bstan pa'i chu mgo so zur gnubs nyang gi phyag gzhes su grags pa o rgyan smin grol gling pa'i lugs ltar bya'o// zhes pa'ang 7skyabs rje dpal sprul rin po che o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhal rgyun bzhin bla ma dam pa lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i phyag bzhes la rang bzo'i tshig gis bslad pa med pas yid ches nges par gyis/ mjang pa bsod nams bstan 'dzin ngor chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos so// slar yang rnga tshig sogs zhib par zhus nas gtsang dag 'dus gsal tshul du kun mkhyen yab sras kyi brgyud 'dzin pa 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros kyis brda go lha ri 'od gsal gling gi chos grwa chen po klong chen snying thig gi 'don cha rnams dang chab gcig par sgrub pa dge legs 'phel/// /
